1.reason: Common mass .2/.1/.3 plus unconditional deficit .2/0/.2 restores p.

2.reason: A is never proposed, but .3 unconditional repair mass reaches A.

3.reason: Strict half-open comparison rejects the boundary; ideal continuous endpoints have zero probability, finite RNG values need an explicit convention.

4.reason: Stop at EOS immediately, and never retain or emit the later proposed suffix.

5.reason: The repaired A needs A context. Reusing B-context q moves .24 mass from AA to AB.

6.reason: Both marginals can remain p while the particular shared-seed coupling changes.

7.reason: Transform and normalize each law before the ratio. Target support excludes C; C proposals reject.

8.next_append_input: Only the repair token at absolute position 7; afterwards computed length becomes 8.

9.physical_move: Update page/table address while preserving logical position.
9.learned_positions: Reinterpreting the same row at a new logical index changes its embedding computation.
9.rotary: Do not rotate an already stored key for a different logical position merely because its physical slot changed.

10.scope: Independent common-alpha model without EOS or output cap.

11.reason: Only the overhead changed; equal acceptance does not guarantee a win.

12.reason: Two contexts may have the same overlap and emitted expectation but different draft/verify cost. Different visitation probabilities then change total expected latency; overlap alone is insufficient.

13.reason: A node sees ancestors and itself, never its sibling; add the common prompt columns separately.

14.reason: Update the active target to the residual before the second test. Independently preferring an accepted ID changes mass allocation.

15.frozen_gradients: Only the new head parameters receive gradients.
15.joint_gradients: Head, backbone and embeddings receive gradients through h_t; the target model may change.

16.EAGLE-1: Advanced token plus target feature predict a next feature, with feature and token objectives.
16.EAGLE-3: Low/middle/high features feed learned state with advanced token and self-generated-state training feedback; do not define it by feature regression.

17.reason: Threshold .4 may stop drafting early. Ensemble .2 targets a mixture, not the original p. Length/EOS can still shorten a fixed-cap round.

18.reason: One pair wins and one loses. No variance estimate or general ranking follows. Freeze prompts, policies, seeds, arms, warmups, order, instrumentation and failure rules before repetitions.
